summary: This section states that the Board of Directors of a Producer Company must make certain important decisions only through resolutions passed at the annual general meeting of its members. These powers include approving budgets, adopting annual accounts, issuing bonus shares, and setting rules for director loans. The directors cannot take these specific actions on their own without member approval.
points: The Board must get approval through resolutions at the annual general meeting for specific matters.
Members must approve the budget and adopt the annual accounts.
The issue of bonus shares and declaration of limited return require member approval at the meeting.
Decisions on patronage bonus and the distribution of patronage must be handled through these resolutions.
The conditions and limits for loans given by the Board to any director must be specified by the members.
Any transaction reserved in the articles for member approval must be approved accordingly.
example: At the annual general meeting of Meera Textiles Private Limited, the members gathered to review the company's financial status for the year. The Board of Directors presented the annual accounts and the proposed budget for the upcoming year to the members for formal adoption and approval. During the same meeting, the members discussed and approved the issuance of bonus shares and the conditions for loans that the Board could give to any director. Because the law requires these specific actions to happen only through resolutions passed at the annual general meeting, the directors waited for the members to vote and pass these resolutions before moving forward with any of these financial decisions.

terms.meaning: A yearly gathering of the company members to discuss and vote on important matters.
An extra payment or benefit given to members based on their business dealings with the company.
Additional shares given for free to existing members of the company.

watch: Do not confuse this with ordinary board meetings, because these specific powers require a resolution passed at the annual general meeting of members.
